senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (अर्षति)
To take, to receive, to choose.
(ई) ऋषी r. 6th cl. (ऋषति)
To go, to approach.

m. (-भः)
1 (In composition,) best, excellent.
2 A bull.
3 A dried plant, one of the eight principal medicaments.
4 The second of the seven notes of the Hindu gamut; in abbreviation, Ri.
5 The first of the twenty-four principal. Jinas or Jaina saints.
6 The hollow of the ear.
7 The name of a mountain.
8 A crocodile's tail.
9 A boar's tail.
f. (-भी)
1 A masculine woman, a woman with a beard, &c.
2 A widow.
3 Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
ऋष to go, अभच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-जः)
A name of ŚIVA.
2 A Jaina saint.
E.
ऋषभ and ध्वज a sign: he whose symbol is a bull.
